requirement: GET /pastes/<id>: id, content, created_at, expires_at (UTC ISO 8601; null if no expiry)
GET /pastes/<id>/raw: content with Content-Type text/plain; charset=utf-8
DELETE with the right token: 204, paste gone
DELETE with a missing or wrong token: 403
Expired paste behaves as nonexistent; expires_at = created + expires_in
Content limit 65,536 UTF-8 bytes; over the limit: 413
Bad JSON, missing/non-string content, invalid expires_in: 400; 1..2,592,000 accepted
Error responses have a JSON body {"error": ...}
Pastes stored under DIR survive a restart
Worked example (JSON body sent with curl's form content type)
[intent] Content stored and returned exactly, whitespace included
